source: six owner phrase corrections in chat

items.owner_native_exact: یہ زِ بہٕ گژھہِ تہِ واتہ  ڈالن، یا کانہہ گسہ نہ  میہ وتہِ ڈالن
items.review_note: Owner wording preserved exactly. Check negation and active/passive structure when composing the whole supplication; this is a request for protection, not an assertion.

items.owner_native_exact: زِ بہٕ گسه  غلطس کن گسن ، یا کانٛہہ کرنایم مےٚ غلطی
items.review_note: Owner wording preserved exactly. Check first-person and causative forms in the composed sentence.

items.owner_native_exact: زِ بہٕ چُھس کٲنٛسہِ تکلیف دِوان، یا کٲنٛه چُھ مےٚ تکلیف دِوان
items.review_note: Owner preference: تکلیف دِوان. Arabic ظلم also includes injustice/wrongdoing; retain that broader sense in later uses.

items.owner_native_exact: یہ زِ بہٕ چھُس کٲنسہِ ستی بیوقوفی کران، یا کانہہ چھہ میه ستی بیوقوفی کران
items.review_note: Owner preference: بیوقوفی کران. Retain active/passive distinction and prayer context.

Owner appended: اکھ الہی صفت۔ محتاط مذہبی لفاظن ہٕنٛز ضرورت. This is editorial explanation, not words to recite. الكريم means noble/generous; عظیم is owner wording and should not become an automatic equivalent in every context.

items.owner_native_exact: تٔمۍ سُند ابدی اختیار تہٕ خودمختاری
items.review_note: Owner preference for eternal authority/sovereignty; inflect within the full sentence.

status: owner wordings recorded; composed dua grammar not independently approved
